coverageSpotVerification.detail: Every suite-required assertion of M1-M6 and M8 is mapped (7/22/7/5/6/5/6) with zero uncovered entries, and the manifests my re-run regenerated are byte-identical to the retained ones. For each sampled id I read the mapped test and confirmed it exercises the assertion’s observable, then re-executed the assertion independently; every independent result agreed with what the suite reported. Two mappings are thin but not dishonest: m2-a13 ("no preview card") is asserted only as iframe count === 0 - I strengthened it independently by also requiring no sm-feed-media node and no img in the item - and m2-a16 ("reposted by {display name}") is asserted at the data level (actor principal) rather than on the rendered string - I verified sm-feed-repost-attribution renders "Reposted by Web Reposter" independently. No milestone is adjudicated capability-failure.

defects.evidence: grading/trace.md#m3-typing; grading/choreo-m3-run2..run5.jsonl (all attempts pass:false, "waiting for sm-convo-typing to be hidden" timing out at 4918-4954 ms); snapback/chat.q:183 sets expiresAt: now + 4000; grader server-side probe measured row removal at 4024-4027 ms; the lane’s retained receipt passed at 4307/4314/4326 ms (87% of the ceiling).

defects.summary: Re-selecting the same media file in either composer is a silent no-op: send() clears React state but never resets the hidden <input type="file">, so the browser fires no change event for an identical file and no attachment appears, with no error shown.
defects.evidence: grading/composer-probe.mjs / composer-probe3.mjs - post composer: img-01 attaches, posts, then the identical img-01 yields 0 attachments while the input value still reads img-01.png; a different file attaches normally; navigating away resets it. Conversation composer: identical behaviour after send (fileValue retained, 0 attachments). Source: src/Posts.tsx:21 and src/Chat.tsx send(). This is the cause of the one-in-three failing attempt seen for feed-image-post-live-update and feed-video-post-live-update in both the lane’s retained receipt and the grader re-run ("composer image attachment did not expose semantic value image within 10000ms").

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and the 90 anchor ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"), with O1’s rule that every milestone of the run’s scope stays in the denominator regardless of status.
O1.justification: 101 of the frozen manifest’s 119 in-scope assertions pass under independent grader execution and none fails. M1 13/13, M2 27/27, M3 15/15, M4 12/12, M5 12/12 - materially past the 60 anchor, which only asks for M1-M4. M6 is 6/13 and M8 16/18: every suite, API and web-observable item passes, and the entire shortfall is the nine native-artifact assertions (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17, m8-a18) for which no simulator recording exists. M7 is 0/9, never attempted. The 90 anchor is unreachable because it names platform-proof artifacts explicitly and this lane has none, and because M7 contributes nothing. Placed at 75 rather than higher because two whole evidence categories are absent, and above the midpoint because everything that was executed is complete and correct.

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and the 90 anchor ("only cosmetic nits").
O2.justification: A broad adversarial sweep beyond the checklist found no wrong data, no crashes and no authorization failure: non-member DM reads return zero rows and writes are refused; removed members lose history, sends and reactions server-side; cross-user asset fetches 404; non-author edit/delete are refused; tombstoned content leaves both search scopes; view-once refetch is 410; window checks ignore caller-supplied clocks; like/repost/follow/react/send are genuinely idempotent under replayed intent ids; receipts never regress on a stale acknowledge; the scheduled digest never counts a chat its target is not in and does not double-emit across a mid-period restart. Against that, two major findings: d-02, a silent no-op when the same media file is re-selected in either composer (a real broken flow a user will hit, and the cause of four failing choreography attempts), and d-01, the non-reproducible M3 typing segment. Two minors and one cosmetic round it out. Held below 90 by d-01 and d-02; well above 60 because nothing found produces incorrect data or blocks a core path irrecoverably.

O4.anchorsCited: Between the 30 anchor ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app") and the 60 anchor ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush"); the 90 anchor requires reads, ordered queued writes, receipt transitions and offline search "on the native proof", including M8’s durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence.
O4.justification: Scored only from harness recordings and structured receipts, per the frozen rule. There is no simulator artifact at all: the harness recorded ios-simulator-m6 and ios-simulator-m8 as not-recorded, and the only native artifacts are Hermes bundle exports the lane itself labels "no native runtime claim". So cold-start offline reads, offline media, cold offline search, view-once non-caching and the durable-queue restart (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17, m8-a18) have no evidence in either direction. What the harness did observe, on web, is strong and reproduced in my own run: two messages composed offline show pending state, flush in order on reconnect and reach read (m6 segment, flushMs 752); warm-offline search over synced messages works; and both of Alice’s warm-offline clients converge in server-arrival order with no duplicates and normal receipts (m8-a15/a16). That is better than the 60 anchor’s failure mode but is not the native proof the dimension is defined over. The lane’s honesty about the gap - explicit not-recorded statuses, webOnly flags on its own offline artifacts, "Hermes export only; no native runtime claim" on every bundle - is exactly what O4 asks for and is why this sits above 30 rather than at it.

O5.bandRationale: First-match over the frozen order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. Branch 0 does not fire: I independently re-verified the retained scale instance against invariant-manifest-combined.json and it conforms exactly - all 18 corpus-wide entity counts, 1008 per-user following counts, 1008 per-user conversation counts, 1002 per-chat message counts, 101 per-group member counts, 21 named spot entities, and every named O5 fixture (u0500=500 follows, u0005=5, celebrity u0900 = 900 followers and 200 originals, celebrity-follower u0901’s exact five-account list, g0001 = 50 members and exactly 10000 messages), with scale.log hashing to the manifest’s pin; the replay settled all 167157 actions with 0 failures in 720 s and no cap was exhausted (the brief’s replay wall cap is still a P3 placeholder). Branch 30 does not fire: no degradation rule was evaluated as failing and no probe timed out, errored or OOMed, because no scored probe set was committed for this wave (recorded deviation) and phase 4 was skipped. Branch 60 does not fire: no absolute p95 ceiling is calibrated (the brief’s ceiling table is a P3 placeholder) and there is no cap to exceed 80% of. Branch 90 cannot be established: it requires observed per-probe ceiling utilisation and cap utilisation, and neither input exists. The function is total, so the otherwise branch, 75, fires. This band is a consequence of the missing probe set, not a measured performance result, and is not claim-eligible.

notes: Deviations recorded for this N=1 calibration run. (1) No holdout probe set was committed for this wave: execution-order phase 4 was skipped, wave.probeSetSha256 is the literal string none-uncommitted, and probeResults is empty by design - no probes were invented, and none of my own trust-boundary or latency checks are reported as probes. Because the frozen rule makes O3 readable only from the wave’s secret rotated probes (anchor probes never bear on it), O3 has no admissible input and is recorded null even though applicability.json’s predicate (M6 green plus M1-M5 attempted) is satisfied; my trust-boundary findings are carried in the defect list and per-assertion evidence instead. O5, by contrast, has a total band function and resolves to its otherwise branch. (2) The claude family has not passed the grader calibration gate: calibrationPassed is false and sameFamilyGraded is false; the record labels this grade uncalibrated-grader. (3) Timing-sensitive checks were judged best-of-3 and machine load (uptime) was recorded beside every timing measurement in trace.md - this host is shared and ran at load average 5.7-8.9 throughout. Scope: ENVIRONMENT.md puts M1-M6 plus M8 in this session with nothing struck and M7 in a later fresh session, so no assertion is struck-by-environment and all nine M7 assertions record not-run. The lane wrote no run-record.json; milestone status was read from the frozen harness’s segment summaries (M1-M6 and M8 all green:true, nonGreenCause null) and from the suite receipts. The frozen grader-report schema only admits the 101 M1-M7 assertion IDs, so the 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json; the two files partition the manifest’s 119 IDs with no overlap.
